messages.author: b8f7cab0a53d1381
messages.subject: Can't use factor variables
parts:
Hi all,

I just installed R and JGR and all that, and everything's going well, but for some reason, I can't enter variables in the Data Viewer if they are factors. Whether I type the name of the factor I designated it to be in the Variable view, or I enter the corresponding number, the cell in the Data view hangs a bit, and then remains empty. All I can do now is to make my group variable an integer type and assign numbers to the groups. That's well and good, but it can get a bit confusing with enough groups.

What's going on? Am I doing something wrong?

Thanks!

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Can't use factor variables
parts:
no, you are not doing anything wrong. A typo slipped into the last version creating this bug. It will be fixed for the next CRAN release.

Best,
Ian
